desc: The RXR22 is the ultimate 22LR semi-automatic rifle for shooters who want simplicity, performance, and customization without breaking the bank. Lightweight and easy to handle, it's built for everything from plinking and target shooting to small-game hunting and tactical-style training. Equipped with a 10-round detachable magazine, the RXR22 ensures quick, smooth reloads. A front rail gives you the freedom to mount grips, lights, bipods, and other accessories, while the adjustable pistol grip delivers a comfortable, ergonomic fit for shooters of all sizes. Whether you're new to rimfire or a seasoned shooter looking for a modern edge, the RXR22 delivers rugged reliability, low-cost shooting, and tactical versatility all in one affordable platform.
